description: This file defines the SerialConnector class, which implements the LinkConnector interface to manage serial port connections, including connecting, restarting, and sending data over a serial interface within the project.

classes.name: SerialConnector
classes.description: Implements serial port connection management, allowing connection initiation, restart, and data transmission for serial communication.

methods.name: SerialConnector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serial port.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a serial connection and schedules opening the port.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the serial connection by closing and reopening the port.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Indicates the connection error state; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Returns the input packet as-is, potentially for processing.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends text data through the serial port, with an option to fire an event.
